notes.subject: pikinini bilong mi
notes.rationale: Tisa i toksave daun long pikinini bilong em, wanpela kain tok long ol Salimo.

notes.subject: klapim han
notes.rationale: תקעת כפיך — pasin bilong klapim han wantaim em i mak bilong kontrak; ol tanim tok olsem 'surety' tasol piksa bilong klapim han i stap.

notes.subject: ערבת
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok olsem 'yu bin joinim/jumulim' — i min 'yu bin bekim man narapela'; sampe ol i tanim 'surety', sampe 'borrow'.

translation: Pikinini bilong mi, sapos yu bin mekim kontrak bilong poroman bilong yu, sapos yu bin klapim han bilong yu long man bilong narapela lain,
